segments.source: AI Saturdays is our community learning programme. You practise AI with other learners, get support from mentors and work together on a project with social impact. A Demo Day gives each team a chance to share what it has built and learned.
segments.en: AI Saturdays is our community learning programme. You practise AI with other learners, get support from mentors and work together on a project with social impact. A Demo Day gives each team a chance to share what it has built and learned.
segments.es: AI Saturdays es nuestro programa de aprendizaje en comunidad. Practicas IA con otras personas, recibes apoyo de mentores y trabajas en equipo en un proyecto con impacto social. El Demo Day permite compartir lo que cada equipo ha creado y aprendido.
